newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said she reiterated her buy rating on Northland Cranberries Inc, which today announced a settlement to litigation brought against it by Ocean Spray Cranberries Inc.
-- The dispute centered on Koller Cranbery Co's 1996 cranberry harvest. Northland acquired the Koller marsh in Wisconsin in July from Koller, an Ocean Spray cooperative member.
-- Under the litigation settlement, Northland will pay an undisclosed amount to Ocean Spray but will retain the Koller crop.
-- Wittenburg said she estimated the settlement, based on recent cranberry prices, at about $300,000.
-- An Ocean Spray spokesman said he could not disclose the amount of the settlement under terms of the agreement.
-- "I think it's a good settlement," Wittenburg said. "Northland Cranberries is not giving anything away."
-- The analyst said she has a $23 target price for the stock.
